card.title: Find the Real Authority
card.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The pipe's still leaking. Which signature releases the repair money?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All three. I've spent all morning getting them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could anyone still freeze it after your morning's work?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finance could. Though they unfroze the roof payment when the caretaker called.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What did the caretaker have: permission to overrule finance, or someone else's direct number?

mechanism: A follows a repair payment through signatures, finance veto and an apparent reversal to locate real decision power.
confusable: Unlike asking how to fill forms, A must keep probing who can overrule whom.
comparison: D54-b distinguishes authority from a direct contact; D54-a distinguishes bank access from permission to pay.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
